# TRXSHOP

> TRXSHOP is a digital marketplace for genuine PC, PlayStation, and Xbox game keys, software, and subscriptions with instant delivery.

TRXSHOP sells 100% genuine digital downloads at competitive prices, with instant delivery after payment. Products include Steam / PC keys, PlayStation and Xbox games, plus popular software and subscription services.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured games, newly added titles, and why gamers trust TRXSHOP.
- [All Games](/games): Full catalog with filters for platform, genre, and price.
- [Contact](/contactus): Support contact and registered merchant information.
- [Terms and Conditions](/terms-and-conditions): Site terms of use.
- [Refund and Cancellation](/refund-and-cancellation): Refund and cancellation policy.
